versions.content: Receiving SwComponentType owns a DataPrototype- Group in the role dpgRequiresCoherency If a receiving SwComponentType owns a DataPrototypeGroup in the role dpgRequiresCoherency for one or sev- eral of its RunnableEntity s it is required that VariableDataPrototype s belong- ing to the same DataPrototypeGroup are produced coherently. This means that the values of the VariableDataPrototype s shall be of the same age.
